title: Not Quality.....  bound to mess up within time!
text:
Not Quality..... bound to mess up within time!. Clothespins take a lot of abuse. They endure the weather if left out, endure knocks to the ground, possible stepped on. Plus, clothespins take a lot of handling. I hang mostly sheets in the winter and other clothes, so I use a lot of clothespins. These are ok with the color, although color may not last long either in the weather and sun..... especially if left out on the line.

The bracket that holds the sticks together is where these go wrong. The clothespin bracket is easy to twist, therefore easy to break off. The price is conducive to the quality of clothespins.
